build_shared_encoder: build a Shared CNN encoder module for continual learning with configurable hidden layers per experiment
build_private_encoder: build a Private task-specific CNN encoder module with per-task convolutional and linear layers
build_acl_network: build a Net model combining Shared and Private encoders with task-specific classification heads
run_forward_pass: run a forward pass through the ACL network with shared and private inputs for a given task
print_model_size: print the model parameter counts and memory size breakdown for shared, private, and head modules
